tag_line: Illegal parking enforcement and towing mod.
title: Tow Service
message:
Tired of chaotic traffic in BeamNG? Take matters into your own hands! Become an illegal parking enforcement officer. Find poorly parked cars, hook them up, and haul them away to the impound lot.

[B]Game Version:[/B] Compatible and tested on BeamNG.drive [B]v0.39[/B].

[B]Visual Navigation:[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]White cylinder[/B] - marks the target vehicle that needs to be towed.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*][B]Green cylinder[/B] - marks the impound lot zone where you must deliver the vehicle.
[/LIST]
[B]Lightweight Code:[/B] Super lightweight script (~[B]15 KB[/B]). No heavy assets, no lag, no broken map edits. It dynamically handles all the logic on the fly.

[B]30 Random Spawn Locations:[/B] Tons of different parking situations and challenges right from the start.

[B]Map Support:[/B] Currently works exclusively on the [B]West Coast USA[/B] map. More official and custom maps will be added in future updates!

[B]Pure Physics Gameplay:[/B] Use your favorite tow truck and test your skills in tight spots. Some vehicles are heavily blocked by poles or walls — you will have to sweat to get them hooked!

[CENTER][B]Alpha Stage:[/B] This is an early stable build of the core gameplay loop. Expect active updates, bug fixes, and new features![/CENTER]
